name: Auto-label incoming Gmail messages with AI nodes
description: Automatically labels incoming Gmail messages using AI. The workflow retrieves message content, suggests labels like Partnership or Inquiry, and assigns them for better organization.

inputs.system:
Your task is to categorize the message according to the following labels.

Partnership - email about sponsored content, cooperation etc.
Inquiry - email about products, services.
Notification - email that doesn't require response. 

One email can have more than one label. Return only label names in JSON format, nothing else. Do not make things up.

blockers.detail: webhook trigger googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE needs webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId

setup: "Gmail trigger": after import, register the googlesuper webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.

hints: "Gmail trigger" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Merge corresponding labels" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Add AI labels to Gmail messages
With this workflow you can automatically set labels for your Gmail message according to its content. 

In this workflow available are 3 labels: "Partnership", "Inquiry" and "Notification". Feel free to adjust labels according to your needs. 

**Please remember to set label names both in your Gmail account and workflow.**

## ⚠️ Note

1. Complete video guide for this workflow is available [on my YouTube](https://youtu.be/a8Dhj3Zh9vQ). 
2. Remember to add your credentials and configure nodes (covered in the video guide).
3. If you like this workflow, please subscribe to [my YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@workfloows) and/or [my newsletter](https://workfloows.com/).

**Thank you for your support!**

### Gmail Trigger
Receive data from Gmail about new incoming message. 

⚠️ Set polling interval according to your needs.

###










### JSON schema
Edit JSON schema and label names according to your needs.

⚠️ **Label names in system prompt and JSON schema should be the same.**

### Merge labels
Combine labels retrieved from Gmail account and assigned by AI together.

### Aggregarte labels and add to message
Create array of label IDs and add to the desired email message in Gmail.

### Get message content
Based on Gmail message ID retrieve body content of the email and pass it to AI chain.

### Assign labels
Let the AI decide which labels suit the best content of the message.

⚠️ **Remember to edit system prompt** - modify label names and instructions according to your needs.
